dataset: Environmental / occupational exposure (暴露史) controlled vocabulary
policy: Canonical exposure.* ids (D17). exposure.* records do not exist yet — this is the vocabulary and the gap map, same approach as symptom_taxonomy.json (D14 build order).
觀察到的暴露資料是一筆觀察值，不是診斷：任何程式路徑都不得將 exposure.* 觀察自動轉為 TCM 證型或病名（D17 §6）。
疑似暴露（suspected）不得自動升級為確診（confirmed）——確認一律需要人工覆核（病史對照、檢測報告等），本檔案的 id 與分類標籤本身不構成升級依據。
`kind` groups exposures by source (environmental / heavy_metal / chemical / occupational / combustion) for filter UI only; it carries no severity or causality weight.
IDs are ASCII (D10). Adding an exposure is a schema change: this file, then the intake form, then any validator that checks exposure.* ids.
applies_to: Case-level exposure observations captured under a future exposure.* field
